notes: Modified cash basis governmental funds; business-type (Electric and Emergency, Water, Sewer, Solid Waste) on accrual basis, so business_type uses the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position Total column (p11, net position) and proprietary cash flows from the Total column (p13), as in FY2023. Business-type disbursement total = Statement of Activities total business-type expenses 5,919,114 (p2) = operating 5,837,171 + interest 75,205 + loan fees 6,738; receipts total computed (operating 7,952,806 + interest 73,379 + grant revenue 129,754). Internal service fund excluded. Governmental receipts/disbursements and transfers from the Total Governmental Funds column (p7). Grant lines with no grantor printed: category other, detail Grants (user ruling 2026-11-12). 'Transportation' expense lines are a context label (other / Other / Miscellaneous Expenses, review). Governmental cash: Balance Sheet p4-5 total assets 8,217,352 (cash and cash equivalents 8,153,123 + county treasurer cash 64,229); beginning cash not printed. Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1), primary government only (component units excluded). General Fund detail from the departmental combining statement (pp23-26, one line per department column; more detailed than the pp16-17 budget schedule, which is not recorded to avoid double counting). Street, Economic Development, Capital Projects, Grant and Debt Service funds from their budget schedules (pp18-22).
